stem: Draw the line passing through the two points $(-3, 1)$ and $(-3, 2)$. Drag the two handles onto these points.
solution: The two points have the same $x$-coordinate, $-3$.
So the line is vertical and every point on it has $x=-3$.

hints.text: Read each pair as (x, y): the first number is how far across, the second how far up.
Compare the x-coordinates of the two points, then place each handle at its point.

notes: Points mode: vertical line cannot be given in equation mode.
